column7: SetProjectMemberRole and SetUserRoles judged the granter ceiling only on roles the request added, so a roles.assign holder who may not grant a role got success when the target already held it (a no-op, or a request that only removed other roles) and a refusal otherwise, which revealed the target's roles. The ceiling is now judged on every requested role before the target's roles are read (REST: TestRoleSetRoutes_RoleBeyondCeiling_403EvenWhenAlreadyHeld).
